title: Pinocchio (capitolo 1)
author: Carlo Collodi
note: Tuscany, in the 1880s: before there was any Pinocchio, an old carpenter finds a very strange piece of wood. The story uses the passato remoto, a literary past tense: when you hear "disse" or "fu", think "said", "was". Collodi writes old Tuscan Italian, so you'll hear forms like "si messe" for "si mise", and "gli è" for "è".

segments.fr: Come andò che Maestro Ciliegia, falegname,
segments.en: How it happened that Master Cherry, a carpenter,

segments.fr: trovò un pezzo di legno che piangeva e rideva come un bambino.
segments.en: found a piece of wood that cried and laughed like a child.

segments.fr: «C'era una volta....»
segments.en: "Once upon a time there was...."

segments.fr: «Un re!» diranno subito i miei piccoli lettori.
segments.en: "A king!" my little readers will say at once.

segments.fr: «No, ragazzi, avete sbagliato.
segments.en: "No, children, you're wrong.

segments.fr: C'era una volta un pezzo di legno.»
segments.en: Once upon a time there was a piece of wood."

segments.fr: Non era un legno di lusso,
segments.en: It wasn't a luxury wood,

segments.fr: ma un semplice pezzo da catasta,
segments.en: but a simple piece from the woodpile,

segments.fr: di quelli che d'inverno si mettono nelle stufe e nei caminetti
segments.en: the kind that in winter you put in stoves and fireplaces

segments.fr: per accendere il fuoco e per riscaldare le stanze.
segments.en: to light the fire and to warm the rooms.

segments.fr: Non so come andasse, ma il fatto gli è
segments.en: I don't know how it happened, but the fact is

segments.fr: che un bel giorno questo pezzo di legno
segments.en: that one fine day this piece of wood

segments.fr: capitò nella bottega di un vecchio falegname,
segments.en: turned up in the workshop of an old carpenter,

segments.fr: il quale aveva nome mastr'Antonio,
segments.en: whose name was Master Antonio,

segments.fr: se non che tutti lo chiamavano maestro Ciliegia,
segments.en: except that everyone called him Master Cherry,

segments.fr: per via della punta del suo naso,
segments.en: because of the tip of his nose,

segments.fr: che era sempre lustra e paonazza, come una ciliegia matura.
segments.en: which was always shiny and purplish-red, like a ripe cherry.

segments.fr: Appena maestro Ciliegia ebbe visto quel pezzo di legno,
segments.en: As soon as Master Cherry had seen that piece of wood,

segments.fr: si rallegrò tutto;
segments.en: he cheered up completely;

segments.fr: e dandosi una fregatina di mani per la contentezza,
segments.en: and giving his hands a little rub out of happiness,

segments.fr: borbottò a mezza voce:
segments.en: he muttered under his breath:

segments.fr: «Questo legno è capitato a tempo;
segments.en: "This wood has turned up just in time;

segments.fr: voglio servirmene per fare una gamba di tavolino.»
segments.en: I want to use it to make a leg for a little table."

segments.fr: Detto fatto, prese subito l'ascia arrotata
segments.en: No sooner said than done, he at once took the sharpened axe

segments.fr: per cominciare a levargli la scorza e a digrossarlo;
segments.en: to start taking off its bark and roughing it down;

segments.fr: ma quando fu lì per lasciare andare la prima asciata,
segments.en: but when he was about to let fly the first blow of the axe,

segments.fr: rimase col braccio sospeso in aria,
segments.en: he stayed with his arm hanging in the air,

segments.fr: perchè sentì una vocina sottile sottile,
segments.en: because he heard a tiny, thin little voice,

segments.fr: che disse raccomandandosi:
segments.en: which said, pleading:

segments.fr: «Non mi picchiar tanto forte!»
segments.en: "Don't hit me so hard!"

segments.fr: Figuratevi come rimase quel buon vecchio di maestro Ciliegia!
segments.en: Imagine how that good old Master Cherry felt!

segments.fr: Girò gli occhi smarriti intorno alla stanza
segments.en: He turned his bewildered eyes around the room

segments.fr: per vedere di dove mai poteva essere uscita quella vocina,
segments.en: to see where on earth that little voice could have come from,

segments.fr: e non vide nessuno!
segments.en: and he saw no one!

segments.fr: Guardò sotto il banco, e nessuno:
segments.en: He looked under the workbench, and no one:

segments.fr: guardò dentro un armadio che stava sempre chiuso, e nessuno;
segments.en: he looked inside a cupboard that was always shut, and no one;

segments.fr: guardò nel corbello dei trucioli e della segatura, e nessuno;
segments.en: he looked in the basket of wood shavings and sawdust, and no one;

segments.fr: aprì l'uscio di bottega
segments.en: he opened the workshop door

segments.fr: per dare un'occhiata anche sulla strada, e nessuno.
segments.en: to take a look out on the street too, and no one.

segments.fr: O dunque?...
segments.en: Well then?...

segments.fr: «Ho capito», disse allora ridendo e grattandosi la parrucca,
segments.en: "I see," he said then, laughing and scratching his wig,

segments.fr: «si vede che quella vocina me la son figurata io.
segments.en: "it's clear that I just imagined that little voice.

segments.fr: Rimettiamoci a lavorare.»
segments.en: Let's get back to work."

segments.fr: E ripresa l'ascia in mano,
segments.en: And taking the axe in hand again,

segments.fr: tirò giù un solennissimo colpo sul pezzo di legno.
segments.en: he brought down a tremendous blow on the piece of wood.

segments.fr: «Ohi! tu m'hai fatto male!»
segments.en: "Ow! You've hurt me!"

segments.fr: gridò rammaricandosi la solita vocina.
segments.en: cried the same little voice, complaining.

segments.fr: Questa volta maestro Ciliegia restò di stucco,
segments.en: This time Master Cherry was dumbstruck,

segments.fr: cogli occhi fuori del capo per la paura,
segments.en: with his eyes popping out of his head with fear,

segments.fr: colla bocca spalancata
segments.en: with his mouth wide open

segments.fr: e colla lingua giù ciondoloni fino al mento,
segments.en: and with his tongue dangling down to his chin,

segments.fr: come un mascherone da fontana.
segments.en: like a carved stone face on a fountain.

glosses.en: carved stone face on a fountain

segments.fr: Appena riebbe l'uso della parola,
segments.en: As soon as he could speak again,

segments.fr: cominciò a dire tremando e balbettando dallo spavento:
segments.en: he began to say, trembling and stammering with fright:

segments.fr: «Ma di dove sarà uscita questa vocina che ha detto ohi?...
segments.en: "But where can this little voice that said ow have come from?...

segments.fr: Eppure qui non c'è anima viva.
segments.en: And yet there's not a living soul here.

segments.fr: Che sia per caso questo pezzo di legno
segments.en: Could it be, by chance, this piece of wood

segments.fr: che abbia imparato a piangere e a lamentarsi come un bambino?
segments.en: that has learned to cry and complain like a child?

segments.fr: Io non lo posso credere.
segments.en: I can't believe it.

segments.fr: Questo legno eccolo qui;
segments.en: This wood, here it is;

segments.fr: è un pezzo di legno da caminetto, come tutti gli altri,
segments.en: it's a piece of wood for the fireplace, like all the others,

segments.fr: e a buttarlo sul fuoco,
segments.en: and if you throw it on the fire,

segments.fr: c'è da far bollire una pentola di fagioli....
segments.en: it's enough to boil a pot of beans....

segments.fr: O dunque? Che ci sia nascosto dentro qualcuno?
segments.en: Well then? Could someone be hidden inside?

segments.fr: Se c'è nascosto qualcuno, tanto peggio per lui.
segments.en: If someone is hidden there, so much the worse for him.

segments.fr: Ora l'accomodo io!»
segments.en: Now I'll fix him!"

segments.fr: E così dicendo, agguantò con tutt'e due le mani
segments.en: And saying this, he grabbed with both hands

segments.fr: quel povero pezzo di legno,
segments.en: that poor piece of wood,

segments.fr: e si pose a sbatacchiarlo senza carità contro le pareti della stanza.
segments.en: and began banging it mercilessly against the walls of the room.

segments.fr: Poi si messe in ascolto,
segments.en: Then he started listening,

segments.fr: per sentire se c'era qualche vocina che si lamentasse.
segments.en: to hear if there was some little voice complaining.

segments.fr: Aspettò due minuti, e nulla;
segments.en: He waited two minutes, and nothing;

segments.fr: cinque minuti, e nulla;
segments.en: five minutes, and nothing;

segments.fr: dieci minuti, e nulla!
segments.en: ten minutes, and nothing!

segments.fr: «Ho capito», disse allora sforzandosi di ridere e arruffandosi la parrucca,
segments.en: "I see," he said then, forcing himself to laugh and ruffling his wig,

segments.fr: «si vede che quella vocina che ha detto ohi,
segments.en: "it's clear that this little voice that said ow,

segments.fr: me la son figurata io! Rimettiamoci a lavorare.»
segments.en: I just imagined it! Let's get back to work."

segments.fr: E perchè gli era entrato addosso una gran paura,
segments.en: And because a great fear had come over him,

segments.fr: si provò a canterellare per farsi un po' di coraggio.
segments.en: he tried humming to give himself a little courage.

segments.fr: Intanto, posata da una parte l'ascia,
segments.en: Meanwhile, having put the axe aside,

segments.fr: prese in mano la pialla,
segments.en: he took the plane in hand,

segments.fr: per piallare e tirare a pulimento il pezzo di legno;
segments.en: to plane the piece of wood and polish it smooth;

segments.fr: ma nel mentre che lo piallava in su e in giù,
segments.en: but while he was planing it up and down,

segments.fr: sentì la solita vocina che gli disse ridendo:
segments.en: he heard the same little voice, which said to him, laughing:

segments.fr: «Smetti! tu mi fai il pizzicorino sul corpo!»
segments.en: "Stop it! You're tickling me all over!"

segments.fr: Questa volta il povero maestro Ciliegia cadde giù come fulminato.
segments.en: This time poor Master Cherry fell down as if struck by lightning.

segments.fr: Quando riaprì gli occhi, si trovò seduto per terra.
segments.en: When he opened his eyes again, he found himself sitting on the floor.

segments.fr: Il suo viso pareva trasfigurito,
segments.en: His face looked completely changed,

segments.fr: e perfino la punta del naso,
segments.en: and even the tip of his nose,

segments.fr: di paonazza come era quasi sempre,
segments.en: from purplish-red, as it almost always was,

segments.fr: gli era diventata turchina dalla gran paura.
segments.en: had turned blue from his great fear.
